See [event packages](https://thirstybeaches.com/utah-dirty-soda-catering#packages), or jump to [weddings](https://thirstybeaches.com/dirty-soda-wedding-catering-utah), [school and church events](https://thirstybeaches.com/dirty-soda-school-church-events-utah) or [company parties](https://thirstybeaches.com/dirty-soda-company-party-utah).

## Festival season, from Steel Days to Fiesta Days

Utah County summers run on city festivals: Steel Days in American Fork, Strawberry Days in Pleasant Grove, Summerfest in Orem, Art City Days in Springville, Fiesta Days in Spanish Fork, plus the Saturday farmers market in Provo. We're not open for public stops yet and we won't make up dates. When we book one of these, it goes on the [homepage stops list](https://thirstybeaches.com/#stops) and the live map. Drop your number there and we'll text you when the trailer is near you. Running a festival or market? Ask about a pop-up stop where guests buy their own drinks.

Across Utah County

[Lehi](https://thirstybeaches.com/dirty-soda-lehi) · Provo · Orem · American Fork · Pleasant Grove · Lindon · Vineyard · Springville · Spanish Fork · Payson · Saratoga Springs · Eagle Mountain · [Salt Lake City](https://thirstybeaches.com/dirty-soda-salt-lake-city)

Questions

## Utah County dirty soda FAQ

**Is there a dirty soda trailer that serves Provo and Orem?**

Yes. Thirsty Beaches is a retro dirty soda trailer based in Lehi that covers Provo, Orem and the rest of Utah County. We're opening soon for public stops and booking events now.

**Can you cater a BYU or UVU event, club night or team party?**

Yes. Student clubs, department socials, team dinners and end-of-semester parties all work. Most campus events need the organizer to clear food vendors and parking with the school, so start that early and we'll send whatever paperwork they ask for.

**Do you do ward parties, trunk-or-treats and stake activities?**

Yes. [Ward and stake activities](https://thirstybeaches.com/dirty-soda-school-church-events-utah) are a big part of what we do in Utah County. Caffeine-free drinks and kid sizes are on the menu, and you can cover the drinks or let families buy their own.

**How far into Utah County will the trailer travel?**

All of it. From Lehi and Saratoga Springs down through Provo, Springville, Spanish Fork and Payson. [Lehi is home base](https://thirstybeaches.com/dirty-soda-lehi), so north county is the shortest drive, and travel for the south end is included in your quote.

**Can we book the trailer for a city festival or market?**

Yes. For festivals, markets and fundraisers, we usually run a pop-up stop where guests buy their own drinks. [Tell us the event and dates](https://thirstybeaches.com/utah-dirty-soda-catering#quote) and we'll work out the vendor details with the organizer.

**How much does it cost to book the trailer?**

It depends on guest count, hours and what you add (soft serve, espresso). Send the date, place and head count and you'll get an exact price within one business day. No deposit is needed to ask.

What shows up

## A soda shop that parks at your party

Thirsty Beaches is a retro drink trailer that brings the whole Utah dirty soda experience to your event: fountain soda over nugget ice, real syrups and fruit purées, a pour of cream, and every drink built to order. Then it does the two things a drive-thru can’t. We run real soft serve, so any soda can turn into a float, and we pull fresh espresso for lattes and sweet-cream cold brew.

You pick the menu. Run the full 114-drink board, or choose a short list of crowd favorites like the Thirst Trap (Dr Pepper, coconut, sweet cream) so the line keeps moving. Zero-sugar versions, caffeine-free lemonades and Italian sodas, and kid sizes mean the grandparents, the toddlers and the Diet Coke loyalists all get something.

Questions

## Before you book

**How far ahead should I book?**

For weddings and big Saturdays, the sooner the better. A month or more out is ideal. For smaller events, ask anyway: if the trailer is free, we’ll come.

**Is this a soda truck I can rent for a party?**

Pretty much. It’s a retro soda trailer we tow to your event and run ourselves, so you get a full mobile soda bar with staff, not an empty truck. Birthdays, graduations, reunions, weddings and company parties all work. Tell us the date and head count and we’ll quote it.

**What’s the difference between a soda bar and a soda shop?**

A soda shop is a drive-thru you go to. A soda bar comes to you: we park at your venue, pour drinks to order for every guest, and you don’t run anyone through a drive-thru line. Ours adds soft serve and espresso, which most soda shops don’t have.

**How much does dirty soda catering cost?**

It depends on guest count, hours and what you add (soft serve, espresso). Send the form and you’ll get an exact price within one business day, with no deposit needed to ask.

**Can guests pay for their own drinks?**

Yes. You can cover everyone, open a tab up to a set amount, or have us run a pop-up where guests buy their own. That last one works well for markets and fundraisers.

**Can we choose the drinks?**

Yes. Pick a short list from the [menu](https://thirstybeaches.com/menu), or let us suggest one for your crowd. We can also name a custom drink after the couple, the school or the company.

**Do you have options for kids and people avoiding sugar or caffeine?**

Yes. Most sodas come in a zero-sugar version, lemonades and Italian sodas have no caffeine, and our Beach Babies sizes are made for kids.

**What do you need from the venue?**

A flat spot for the trailer close to your guests, and a way to drive a truck and trailer in. We’ll confirm parking and power details with you when we quote.

**Do you travel outside St. George, Utah County and Salt Lake?**

Often, yes. Tell us where your event is and we’ll include any travel in the quote. St. George and Washington County are where we open first: see [dirty soda in St. George](https://thirstybeaches.com/dirty-soda-st-george). We also do events on Florida’s Gulf Coast, Tampa Bay to Naples: see [Florida catering](https://thirstybeaches.com/florida-dirty-soda-catering).

Book the trailer

## Get a quote

Tell us the basics and we’ll reply within one business day with availability and a price. No deposit, no obligation.

What shows up

## A Utah soda shop, parked on the Gulf Coast

Dirty soda is Utah’s drink: fountain soda over nugget ice, real syrups and fruit purées, and a pour of cream, every drink built to order. Thirsty Beaches brings it to Florida in a retro trailer, then adds the two things that matter in Gulf Coast heat. We run real soft serve, so any soda can turn into a float, and we pull fresh espresso for iced lattes and sweet-cream cold brew.

Most Florida crowds haven’t had a dirty soda yet, so the trailer gets noticed. Pick a short list of easy wins like the Thirst Trap (Dr Pepper, coconut, sweet cream) or a pineapple-coconut Sprite, or run the full board. Zero-sugar versions, caffeine-free lemonades and Italian sodas, and kid sizes cover everyone from the grandparents to the toddlers.

Questions

## Before you book

**What is a dirty soda?**

A fountain soda, like Dr Pepper, Coke or Sprite, mixed with flavored syrups or fruit purée and topped with a splash of cream. It started in Utah drive-thrus. See the full [menu](https://thirstybeaches.com/menu).

**How far ahead should I book?**

For weddings and busy winter-season weekends, a month or more out is ideal. For smaller events, ask anyway: if the trailer is free, we’ll come.

**Is this a soda truck I can rent for a party?**

Pretty much. It’s a retro soda trailer we tow to your event and run ourselves, so you get a full mobile soda bar with staff, not an empty truck. Birthday parties, HOA socials, weddings and company events all work, from Tampa Bay to Naples.

**How much does it cost?**

It depends on guest count, hours and what you add (soft serve, espresso). Send the form and you’ll get an exact price within one business day, with no deposit needed to ask.

**Can you set up at the beach?**

The trailer needs a flat, firm spot it can be driven to, like a parking lot, driveway, lawn edge or venue pad, so we usually set up at the venue or the closest lot to the sand. Tell us the spot and we’ll work out the best setup when we quote.

**Can guests pay for their own drinks?**

Yes. You can cover everyone, open a tab up to a set amount, or have us run a pop-up where guests buy their own. That last one works well for markets, HOA events and fundraisers.

**Do you have options for kids and people avoiding sugar or caffeine?**

Yes. Most sodas come in a zero-sugar version, lemonades and Italian sodas have no caffeine, and our Beach Babies sizes are made for kids.

**Do you do events in Utah too?**

Yes. The trailer opens first in [St. George](https://thirstybeaches.com/dirty-soda-st-george) and also works Utah’s Wasatch Front: see [Utah catering](https://thirstybeaches.com/utah-dirty-soda-catering).

# Privacy Policy

> What Thirsty Beaches collects, how we use it, and how to reach us.

Canonical page: https://thirstybeaches.com/privacy

The fine print


Effective October 25, 2026

Thirsty Beaches is a mobile dirty soda trailer. This page explains what we collect when you use thirstybeaches.com, order from our kiosk or your phone, or sign up for texts, and what we do with it. Short version: we collect as little as we can, we never sell it, and we never share your phone number with anyone for marketing.

## What we collect

- **Text and email alerts.** If you sign up, we keep your phone number or email address, the date you joined, and that you agreed to hear from us.
- **Orders.** When you order at the kiosk, on your phone, or ahead online, we get the drinks you picked and the first name you give us so we can call your order. Payments are handled by our payment processor, Clover. We never see or store your card number.
- **Punch card.** Your card lives in your browser under a random ID. If you choose to save it to your phone number, we store a scrambled (hashed) version of the number and its last 4 digits, not the number itself.
- **Event quotes.** If you ask for a catering quote, we keep what you type in the form (like your name, email, phone, event date and city) so we can reply.
- **Photos for drink matching.** "Match My Vibe", "Snap a pic" and the website's drink mixer send one photo to an AI service to suggest a drink. The photo is used for that one request and is not stored by us. Our AI provider may hold it for up to 30 days for safety checks, then deletes it. Ages 13+ only.
- **The basics every website gets.** Our hosting provider sees standard technical details like your IP address and browser type. We use them to keep the site running and to stop abuse, like too many requests.

## How we use it

- To make and hand you your drink, and to take payment through Clover.
- To text or email you about where the trailer is parked and our specials, only if you signed up.
- To answer your quote request and follow up about your event.
- To keep your punch card working, including moving it to a new phone.

## Who we share it with

We don't sell or rent your information. We only share it with the services that run Thirsty Beaches for us, and only what they need: Clover (payments), Cloudflare (website hosting), our text message provider (sending texts), our email provider (sending email), and an AI provider for the drink-matching features. **We do not share your mobile number or text-message consent with anyone for their own marketing.**

## Text messages

Signing up for texts is optional and never required to buy anything. Message frequency varies, message and data rates may apply. Reply **STOP** to any message to stop, or **HELP** for help. The full details are in our [Text Message Terms](https://thirstybeaches.com/sms-terms).

## Keeping and deleting it

We keep alert signups until you unsubscribe, and quote requests and order details only as long as we need them to run the business. To see, change or delete what we have about you, email [hello@thirstybeaches.com](mailto:hello@thirstybeaches.com) and we'll take care of it.

## Kids

Our kiosk is family friendly, but our sign-up lists are meant for adults. We don't knowingly collect contact details from children under 13. If you think a child signed up, email us and we'll remove it.

## Changes

If we change this policy, we'll update this page and the date at the top.

## Contact

Questions? Email [hello@thirstybeaches.com](mailto:hello@thirstybeaches.com).

# Text Message Terms

> Thirsty Beaches text alerts: what you get, how often, and how to stop.

Canonical page: https://thirstybeaches.com/sms-terms

The fine print


Effective October 25, 2026 · updated November 15, 2026

**Program:** Thirsty Beaches stops and specials

**What you'll get:** texts about where the trailer is parked, when we open, and specials

**How often:** message frequency varies, usually a few times a month

**Cost:** message and data rates may apply

**Stop anytime:** reply **STOP** · **Help:** reply **HELP** or email [hello@thirstybeaches.com](mailto:hello@thirstybeaches.com)

## Signing up

You join by entering your phone number in the "Know before we roll up" form on [thirstybeaches.com](https://thirstybeaches.com/#stops) and checking the box that says you agree to get texts. Agreeing is never required to buy anything. We then send one text asking you to reply **YES**. You are not added to the list, and get no stops or specials texts, until you reply YES. You must be 13 or older and the number must be yours.

## Stopping texts

Reply **STOP** to any text and you'll get one last message confirming you're unsubscribed, then no more texts. You can also [unsubscribe on this site](https://thirstybeaches.com/unsubscribe) or email [hello@thirstybeaches.com](mailto:hello@thirstybeaches.com) and ask us to remove your number. To join again, sign up on the website.

## Getting help

Reply **HELP** to any text, or email [hello@thirstybeaches.com](mailto:hello@thirstybeaches.com).

## Carriers

Carriers are not liable for delayed or undelivered messages. Texts are sent to US mobile numbers only.

## Your privacy

We never sell or share your mobile number or your consent with anyone for their own marketing. See our [Privacy Policy](https://thirstybeaches.com/privacy) for everything we collect and how we use it.

## Changes

If these terms change, we'll update this page and the date at the top.
